about.title: About
about.heading: About AIvalon
about.description: A local, single-user AI roleplay app — chat sessions, character cards, and lorebooks, talking to any OpenAI-compatible backend (Ollama, llama.cpp, a hosted API) you point it at.
about.authorship_text: Co-written by Lord (design, product calls, review) and AI coding agents (implementation) — every feature here passed through a human decision before landing, but a meaningful share of the code itself was AI-generated. Said plainly so nobody mistakes this for entirely hand-written software.

world.title: World
world.intro: Lorebooks: world info the narrator can draw on. Attach one to a session in Chat.
world.empty: No lorebooks yet — add one above, then open it to add entries.
world.entries_empty: No entries yet — add one below.
world.field_trigger_help: When this entry's content gets shown to the narrator. "Constant" = every single message, no matter what you write. "Selective" = only when one of the Keys above appears as a whole word in your last message (e.g. key "dragon" only fires if you actually typed "dragon").
world.field_order_help: Only matters when several entries fire on the same message: lower number goes first in what the narrator reads. Leave at 0 unless you have entries that need a specific order relative to each other.
world.field_probability_help: Even when this entry would fire (constant, or its key matched), only include it this % of the time — a dice roll on top of the trigger. 100 = always, no randomness. Leave at 100 unless you deliberately want this fact to show up inconsistently.
world.field_enabled_help: Switches this entry off without deleting it — handy for a fact that's temporarily outdated or spoils something, since you keep the text saved to re-enable later.
vault.setup_intro_html: No PIN set yet — choose one to start keeping sessions here. You'll need to retype it every time you take a session back out of the vault.
vault.empty_chats: Nothing in the vault — move a session here from its own options menu in Chats.

vault.empty_worlds: No hidden lorebooks — move one here from its options menu in Worlds (list view).
vault.delete_vault_tooltip: Delete the vault and everything in it
vault.reset_warning_html: This will delete everything in the vault — every hidden chat, character and world, and the vault itself. There is no undo.
settings.title: Settings
settings.profiles_empty: No backend profile yet — add one below to start chatting.
settings.persona_intro: How you're represented to the AI. A session with none picked uses a built-in default ("User").
settings.persona_empty: No persona yet — add one below, or skip it and sessions use the "User" default.
settings.prompt_help_html: How the world/narrator is instructed. Placeholders: {{persona_name}}, {{persona_description}}, {{characters}} (the attached character cards, or a fallback instruction to improvise when there are none), and {{lorebook}} (the session's attached Lorebook's entries that are active this turn — see World).
settings.image_presets_intro: Named txt2img settings for image generation. Each chat picks one in its session panel’s Gallery tab; a chat with none picked uses A1111’s defaults.
settings.image_presets_empty: No image preset yet — add one below.
settings.context_budget_help: Upper limit on what's sent to the model per reply (system prompt + chat history). Roughly 4 characters per token, so 24000 ≈ 6k tokens — keep it comfortably under your backend's context size. When a long chat goes over, the oldest messages are left out first (the system prompt never is) and the chat page says so. 0 means no limit.
settings.whitelist_label: Allowed domains for URL imports (one per line)
settings.whitelist_help: Character Card PNG imports from these domains are allowed in addition to 127.0.0.1; JSON imports are always restricted to 127.0.0.1. Exact hostname match (www.example.com and example.com are different entries); port is ignored.
settings.kind_help: Which API shape this backend speaks — picks what "Test connection" checks and what the profile shows up for later (LLM backend picker vs. image generation).
settings.api_key_placeholder_set: •••••••• (leave blank to keep the current key)
settings.preset_name_help: Shown in each chat’s preset picker. Must be unique (case doesn’t count).
settings.style_suffix_help: Appended to the prompt as “, suffix” — what makes a preset look manga vs. photo vs. cyberpunk.
settings.negative_prompt_help: What to steer away from (blur, extra fingers, watermarks…).
settings.steps_help: Denoising iterations — more is slower; 20–30 is typical.
settings.cfg_scale_help: How strictly to follow the prompt — 5–8 is typical; too high looks overcooked.
settings.height_help: Pixels. Taller than wide suits portraits.
settings.sampler_help: Sampler name exactly as Automatic1111's own dropdown spells it.
settings.seed_help: -1 = random each time; reuse a seed (shown under each image) to reproduce it.
settings.backend_help: Locks this preset to one image backend (its checkpoint) — the "Generate image" dialog then skips asking which backend to use. Leave on "(Choose at generation time)" to keep picking manually.
